content.name: Magic Powder - 2
content.description: 本题与前一题的题意相同，唯一的区别是限制条件更加严格。
content.formatI:
第一行包含两个正整数 $n$ 和 $k$（$1 \leq n \leq 100000, 1 \leq k \leq 10^{9}$），分别表示原料的种类数和魔法粉的克数。

第二行包含序列 $a_{1}, a_{2}, ..., a_{n}$（$1 \leq a_{i} \leq 10^{9}$），其中第 $i$ 种原料制作一个饼干所需的克数。

第三行包含序列 $b_{1}, b_{2}, ..., b_{n}$（$1 \leq b_{i} \leq 10^{9}$），其中 $b_{i}$ 表示 Apollinaria 拥有的第 $i$ 种原料的克数。
content.formatO: 输出 Apollinaria 能够利用现有原料和魔法粉制作的最大饼干数。

en.name: Magic Powder - 2
en.description: The term of this problem is the same as the previous one, the only exception — increased restrictions.
en.formatI:
The first line contains two positive integers $ n $ and $ k $ ( $ 1<=n<=100000,1<=k<=10^{9} $ ) — the number of ingredients and the number of grams of the magic powder.

The second line contains the sequence $ a_{1},a_{2},...,a_{n} $ ( $ 1<=a_{i}<=10^{9} $ ), where the $ i $ -th number is equal to the number of grams of the $ i $ -th ingredient, needed to bake one cookie.

The third line contains the sequence $ b_{1},b_{2},...,b_{n} $ ( $ 1<=b_{i}<=10^{9} $ ), where the $ i $ -th number is equal to the number of grams of the $ i $ -th ingredient, which Apollinaria has.
en.formatO: Print the maximum number of cookies, which Apollinaria will be able to bake using the ingredients that she has and the magic powder.
